description: Source code for API handlers related to 'Scheme' management in Mattermost, including CRUD operations and permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API handler struct for scheme-related endpoints.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object encapsulating request, response, session, and application state.

methods.name: InitScheme
methods.description: Initializes route handlers for scheme management endpoints.

methods.name: createScheme
methods.description: Handles creation of a new scheme, including permission and license checks.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves a specific scheme by ID, with permission validation.

methods.name: getSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of schemes with optional scope filtering.

methods.name: getTeamsForScheme
methods.description: Fetches teams associated with a specific scheme, validating scope and permissions.

methods.name: getChannelsForScheme
methods.description: Fetches channels associated with a specific scheme, validating scope and permissions.

methods.name: patchScheme
methods.description: Updates an existing scheme with provided patch data, including audit logging.

methods.name: deleteScheme
methods.description: Deletes a scheme by ID, with permission and license validation.
